author: Jennifer Salazar
title: Vetr Downgrades Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) to Buy
text:
Posted by Jennifer Salazar on Apr 28th, 2018 // No Comments
Vetr cut shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) from a strong-buy rating to a buy rating in a research report report published on Monday, April 2nd. The firm currently has $186.86 target price on the iPhone maker’s stock.
Other equities analysts have also issued reports about the company. UBS set a $190.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a buy rating in a research note on Monday, December 4th. Rosenblatt Securities set a $180.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a buy rating in a research note on Tuesday, December 26th. Loop Capital reiterated a buy rating and issued a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, December 22nd. BMO Capital Markets reissued a buy rating and set a $199.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, December 20th. Finally, Citigroup reissued a buy rating and set a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, December 13th. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the stock. The company has a consensus rating of Buy and a consensus target price of $203.15. Get Apple alerts:
Apple stock traded down $1.90 during trading on Monday, hitting $162.32. The company’s stock had a trading volume of 35,616,912 shares, compared to its average volume of 29,412,336. The firm has a market capitalization of $833,254.44, a P/E ratio of 17.62, a PEG ratio of 1.25 and a beta of 1.25. Apple has a 1-year low of $142.20 and a 1-year high of $183.50. The company has a current ratio of 1.24, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period in the prior year, the firm posted $3.36 earnings per share. equities analysts predict that Apple will post 11.3 EPS for the current year.

About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
